# per-example budget (the sweep compiles at -O0).  It compiles + links + starts
# running fine — only completion is slow; convergence is gated by the
# (timeout-free) run-tests lane via test/Run/rl_ddpg.m.

# GPU Coder T1-T7 — the validation suite at examples/gpu/ exercises advanced
# patterns (stencil, parfor+GPU, multi-GPU, full benchmark) that are deferred
# per docs/gpu_coder_roadmap.md.  The simpler GPU examples (mandelbrot.m,
# test_gpu_*.m) work; the entries below are the documented carve-outs.
# mandelbrot_gpu.m LINKs against the Metal-host variant which needs Metal SDK
# objects not in the AOT runtime set.  The three `test_gpuarray_*` fixtures
# are function-only files (no top-level statements -> matlabc doesn't
# synthesize a `main()`), so they LINK-fail standalone.  Issue #22 (the
# `single()`/`double()` dispatch gap) is fixed and gated by
# test/Run/single_cast_in_builtin_arg.m; what's left here is the orthogonal
# function-only-needs-main / multi-file-resolution gap.

gpu/mandelbrot_gpu.m                               # LINK  (Metal host-driver, needs Metal SDK objects)
gpu/run_validation_suite.m                         # EMIT  (multi-file resolution: calls test_gpuarray_*.m by name)
